title: CKS-MATH-64-2026: The 15.19ms Render Lag as Bilateral Parity Product
abstract:

Universe proven as fault-tolerant write-audit-render engine where perception lags substrate by mandatory S-count verification cycle.

**Key Result:** τ=J×S not J/S | J=7.595ms | Write→Mirror→Verify | RAID-1 protocol | Consciousness post-audit | Superposition=unverified
